name: Qutebrowser
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: Qutebrowser as the default Omarchy browser — all 22 stock themes, KeePassXC password fill, ad-free YouTube, and built-in ad blocking.

features: 22 Omarchy themes with automatic switching on omarchy theme set
KeePassXC password fill via qute-keepassxc userscript
YouTube ad-free via Greasemonkey script + fetch/XHR interception
Built-in host + Adblock filter-list ad blocker (Brave + EasyList)
AI per-site fixes (qute-ai-fix) applied via generated per-domain Greasemonkey scripts
Sets qutebrowser as the system default browser
